content: Hello, Sir. What can I do for you today?
I need to find a new way of getting my insurance.
We've just started a new business at this bank, Bank-Insurance Link.
Could you give me some details about that?
Certainly. It could really benefit someone like you. Besides insurance for you, you can also get more or less dividends from the insurance company.
That sounds great. More dividends if I want to purchase them!
There are two different types that we are offering at the moment, Dividend Deposit and Dividend Participated Deposit.
I'll go through the materials that you have given me and return shortly. Thanks.
